summary: TDS subsidiary Array (formerly UScellular) sold select spectrum assets to Verizon for $1.0B cash, disclosed on Form 8-K Item 2.01. The purchase price was paid at closing on June 1, 2026. No board recommendation or advisors named. Post-closing, Array declared an $11.00/share special cash dividend to common and Series A holders, with TDS holding ~70.8M shares. The transaction simplifies TDS's structure and provides cash to shareholders. No regulatory clock or break fees disclosed. Watch for completion of remaining asset sales and the special dividend payout on June 25, 2026.
